messages.author: 3fd30254cc2deeb1
messages.subject: prior distribution for bayesian estimations
parts:
As I understand the multivariate normal prior distribution is used for the estimation of factor scores. What about the mean and standart deviation of this normal distribution.  
Is it possible to specify and manipulate the prior density distribution for the latent traits when estimating the thetas via bayesian methods (EAP, MAP)?

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: prior distribution for bayesian estimations
parts:
Yes. See this wiki vignette which demonstrates the theta recovery given alternative prior distribution shapes (in this case, a bi-modal distribution with peaks at +-1). 

http://philchalmers.github.io/SimDesign/html/04-Auxillary_parameter_recovery.html 
 
Phil
